releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.18:
- Beer Option & Comanda Fix: Fully resolved beer selection modal hierarchy and display layering so tapping beers immediately displays serving options (Bottle, Can, Bucket) and adds to the order.
- Modal Hierarchy & DOM Normalization: Perfectly balanced all HTML modal tags and ensured high z-index overlays across all stations.
- Bar & Nightclub Bottle Setup: Streamlined catalog with immediate barcode scan, direct USB/COM scale weight capture for full/empty bottles, and Save & Next flow.
- Unified Bottle Inventory: Single consolidated bottle + open ounces stock pool. Auto-deducts full bottles or shot volume without double ledgers.
- Beer Bucket Mix & Match: Prompt for Bottle, Can, or Bucket (5 or 6 pack) with interactive beer counter and detailed comanda printing.
- Printed Receipt Tender & Change: Accurate cash received and change due printed on customer and merchant receipts.
- Product Card Visual Contain: Bottle and beverage product photos display fully contained and centered without clipping.
- Split by Customer in Checkout: Instant access to Split Bill modal directly from Register Payment screen.
- Station Setup KDS Routing: Native Kitchen Display and Bar Display station roles selectable directly in Impossible POS setup wizard.
